listIntro: The season's work packages, their progress and their next deadlines.
newIntro: Describe the expected work; it is split into Deliverables afterwards.
inboxIntro: The proposals awaiting your decision, then your own and how they stand.
emptyList: No Work Order matches these filters.
budgetHint: Set by the Head of department, from 1 to 5.
budgetLockedHint: The Work Order is active: any change of the budget needs a reason.
objectivesHint: What must exist or work at the end.
coordinatorHint: The coordinator follows the whole; this does not replace the Deliverable assignments.
createsOfficial: You head this department: the Work Order is official as soon as it is created (as a draft).
createsProposal: You do not head this department: this will be a proposal, which the Head of department approves or rejects. You may also save it as a draft and submit it later.

proposalExplain.draft: This draft has not been sent yet: submit it for the Head of department to decide.
proposalExplain.pending_review: This proposal awaits the decision of the Head of department. It is not official work yet.
proposalExplain.rejected: This proposal was rejected; it no longer changes.

editBeforeDeciding: You may edit the details before deciding (the “Edit” button); this is not a third decision.
decisionNoteHint: Optional to approve, required to reject.
rejectNeedsNote: Explain the rejection in the note.
rejectConfirmText: Its author will see this note. A rejected proposal can no longer change.
activateFailed: The Work Order cannot be activated yet:
cancelText: Its open Deliverables are cancelled with it. This cannot be undone.
membersHint: The people assigned to its Deliverables.
membersChosen: {count, plural, one {# member chosen} other {# members chosen}}
rubricHint: Four ratings from 1 to 5; they suggest a budget, which you then set.
addDeliverableHint: An official Deliverable, with its criteria, dates, weight and members.
proposeDeliverableHint: The Head of department approves it (setting its dates and members) or rejects it.
deadlineBeforeStart: The deadline cannot be before the start date.
allocationBudget: Work Order budget: {tier} / 5. Each Deliverable receives budget × weight.
allocationNoBudget: Set the budget first to see the allocated points.
weightInvalid: A weight goes from 0 to 100 %, to the thousandth.
weightMustBeHundred: The weights of an active Work Order must total 100 % (now {total} %).
weightNotYetHundred: Current total: {total} %. It must reach 100 % before activation.
dependenciesHint: The dependencies of its Deliverables, between them or with other work.
toDecideHint: The proposals of your departments awaiting your decision.
mineHint: What you proposed and where the decision stands.
noProposals: You have not proposed anything yet.
